title: Planet Tweaks V3.4.8 - Icons Restored, Instant Tab Switching, Win32 Crosshair & 16 CPU Tweaks
releaseNotes: Planet Tweaks V3.4.8: (1) Full Icon Restoration & Clean Sidebar: Restored every navigation icon, header control, close button, and modal badge; removed duplicate/extra tabs (System Info, standalone Themes mixer, duplicate Input & Crosshair, duplicate Debloat Apps) and kept clean Themes inside Settings. (2) Instant Tab Switching & Scroll-to-Top Fix: Fast registry probes + 20s DetectCmd cache + background parallel probe refresh eliminate tab-switch hangs and always reset scroll to top. (3) Hardware-Clipped Zero-Delay Crosshair Studio: Side-by-side preview workbench, restored rainbow HSV spectrum slider, 100% solid Win32 ExtCreateRegion overlay (zero WS_EX_LAYERED dimming at 100% opacity), and 16 safe Desktop CPU tweaks restored.
